# Bundled fonts

All three are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (full text in `OFL.txt` in this
folder). The files are in `composeApp/src/commonMain/composeResources/font/`, taken from the
`@expo-google-fonts` npm packages, unmodified.

| Font | Used for | Copyright |
|---|---|---|
| Barlow Condensed (SemiBold, Bold) | Headings and stats, road-sign style | Copyright 2017 The Barlow Project Authors (https://github.com/jpt/barlow) |
| Inter (Regular, Medium, SemiBold) | Body text and controls | Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter) |
| Caveat (SemiBold) | Handwritten captions in the Film album theme | Copyright 2014 The Caveat Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/caveat) |

The licence requires keeping these notices and the licence text with any copy of the fonts;
the app should also show them on an "About" or licences screen before a public release.
